orders.title: orders
orders.description: 10 visible orders. Assessment also checks larger fixtures with nulls, ties and boundary values.

commerce.title: commerce
commerce.description: 52 customers and 310 orders, with skewed customer activity, missing matches, duplicate line values and multiple payments. Unattached payments have a null order_id. Declared orders.total is independent of the line-item calculation; use the measure requested by the exercise. Assessment changes sizes and distributions.

commerce_writes.title: commerce writes
commerce_writes.description: Disposable commerce write lab: only orders permits INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE; other tables stay read-only and all constraints remain enforced. The visible fixture adds pending order 900000 for customer 109 with total 25 at 2026-01-11 UTC. Fresh assessments also vary its amount or omit it to exercise the insert branch of an upsert. Each exercise owns a separate lab; Reset restores its starting data.

scan_orders.title: 100k scan orders
scan_orders.description: 100,000 read-only synthetic orders with 192-character payloads, exact decimal amounts, unknown totals and fixed UTC time boundaries. The visible hot customer 1 owns 65% of orders; fresh variants change this to 45% and 25%. Customer 777 has both known and unknown totals, including three all-null events on January 11 UTC. B-tree indexes: primary id, customer_id, ordered_at and status. Each exercise creates its own disposable lab on demand; Reset restores it. This is the 100k interactive profile, not the optional 2m/10m profiles.

join_orders.title: 100k relational orders
join_orders.description: Read-only synthetic commerce: 1,000 customers, 100,000 orders, over 200k line items and over 180k payment events. Reuses the scan profile with hot customer 1 at 65% / 45% / 25% across variants. Names repeat; customers 999 and 1000 have no orders. Child rows include missing relationships, repeated identical values, mixed payment statuses and one unassigned captured payment. Every matched child has a validated foreign key and indexed order_id. Separate child rollups preserve physical row multiplicity. Each exercise owns a disposable lab; Reset restores it. This is the 100k interactive profile; larger profiles remain outstanding.
